text:
renee: Heads-up: we're running a Community Maintainers Hack Day next Tues to ship a few small open-source releases and onboarding fixes. goal: land 3 tiny improvements and one docs refresh. sign-up + agenda: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-hackday :calendar:
lila: sweet. what kinds of tasks?
renee: short list in the repo: label cleanup, small ux fixes for redwoodctl docs, add a CONTRIBUTING quickstart, and cut a patch release for community-extensions (0.3.1).
marco: I'll volunteer to cut the release and handle the release notes. can we get someone on docs?
lila: I'll take the docs quickstart. can someone own CI flakiness for the example apps?
ops-bot: ops-bot: CI status note: example-apps flaky tests reported in last 24h; flakiness-priority label suggested.
marco: noted. tagging @renee to coordinate CI triage during the window.
renee: assigned marco for releases, lila for docs, i'll triage CI with help from eng-infra. comms, can you help with a short blurb for community channels?
comms: yep. draft: "Join Redwood Community Maintainers Hack Day — contribute small fixes, improve onboarding, and help ship releases. Tues 10–4 PT. No prior maintainer experience required." want me to shorten?
lila: sounds good. maybe add "snacks and virtual coffee" emoji to keep it friendly. :coffee:
marco: quick checklist for the cut: bump version in package.json + setup.py, run tests, build assets, tag v0.3.1, GH release with changelog. I'll post a checklist in the repo's releases issue.
renee: thanks. reminder: prefer surface-level changes only (no architecture rewrites). keep PRs small.
marco: will use `release-draft` label and request reviews from @eng-platform and @devex.
comms: I'll schedule a 20s announcement to #community and the newsletter.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: docs preview build queued for branch hackday/docs-update :rocket:
lila: will open the CONTRIBUTING PR tomorrow morning with a short quickstart and examples.
renee: lovely. if anyone needs priority review, ping me in this thread. closing for now but will reopen with links during the event. :wave:
